title: The Invoice list report's status filter has Closed, unselected by default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Invoice list report in Accounting.
  2. Open its status filter.
  3. Select "Closed".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens with its default totals; work order 1 is not in them.

Step 2:

  • "Closed" is a value of the filter and is not selected.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 is listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R6: “The Invoice list report's status filter gets the value Closed, unselected by default, so the default report and its totals are unchanged. The Accounting Sales Invoices page shows Closed records with the Closed pill and the badge, and its Status filter (default All) gets the value Closed; there is no Classification filter in this version.”
